confessions of a page admin

2,758,198 views. 101 posts. four months. thai language

i open the editor once a week https://t.co/XxTABrs8UW

so it's a rented room

rent is free. so is the revenue

the money, since someone always asks

2,758,198 views. facebook has paid me nothing for any of them

the $1.34 in my dashboard is stars. tips from readers

view payouts need 10k followers and approval. still not reaching that yet https://t.co/KS9imZNdan

the page reaches people through 7 facebook groups i don't own

one admin didn't approve one post. it did 12 shares. median is 155
some of that is arithmetic. bigger follower base, fewer strangers per post, and follows only come from stranger

five of my six august posts converted zero followers

the sixth did 130

the page didn't stop working. it stopped working broadly https://t.co/AYXK5h7KVN

nobody shares a framework

they share the two lines they can paste into their own file

i've known this for months and i still write the framework first

my smartest work performed worst

a governance protocol for parallel ai sessions did 1,593 views

a post about editing claude md file did 367,196 https://t.co/5pq47NaYuA

what crossed:

posts you act on with a file you already have. 30,883 median views

posts where you install something first. 13,520

i keep every stat so i can compare it https://t.co/7U8wd4Xe4D

translation is the easy half

most of what goes viral in english just doesn't survive the trip. wrong stack. or the reference means nothing here. or the problem hasn't arrived yet

picking is the job

the edge under it is arbitrage

i read english ai content every morning, then write it in thai

there's a lag between what ships on X and what reaches a thai dev group

101 posts in 18 weeks. three a week now

i have never posted live. not once

consistency isn't discipline. it's a queue

everything get done on sundays afternoon  and scheduled 

and the page looks like it's always on https://t.co/gZ9Fyy3evy
